title: Gradientless Causal Circuit Compiler — discovering grounded role bindings from unsegmented raw acoustic/physical interventions
question: Can a zero-gradient compiler construct reusable, role-aware numerical circuits from observed raw-bit strings and physical interventions, without supplied codewords/grammar/latent semantic labels or pretrained weights, and avoid WSP53's ambiguity and order-collapse?
hypothesis: Shared raw-symbol segmentation constraints plus physically grounded identity and causal role invariance may support numerical circuit construction with fewer wrong-confident predictions than WSP53 count-only; noncommuting operator identification must be evaluated separately; no claim of novelty or intelligence without independent search.

source.type: Read-only reuse of WSP53 frozen source.py via evaluator-only tests. Learner must never import or receive source, its hidden codebook, grammar, semantic triples, heldout outputs, or evaluator state.
source.cohorts: SELFTEST 9901,9902 identity/permuted/rotated only; DEV and PRIMARY explicitly forbidden; leave WSP53 prereg untouched.
source.prior: Raw binary acoustic signal comprises up to three latent bounded 4–6-bit causal segments; categorical physical inputs and directly observed interventions are allowed. Candidate constraints: persistent entity address, observable orientation-effect role, additive modular effect decomposition. Prior is declared and must be charged; it may favor source family, not claim universal learning.
source.data_budget: Exactly 48 phase A and 12 phase B charged interventions per family/fixture; no extra interactions; no heldout training; run across 12 WSP53 SELFTEST worlds.

mechanism: Enumerate candidate raw partitions, infer and bind physical entity addresses from changed public registers, search role and effect hypotheses that consistently explain observed interventions, compile their surviving transformations into bounded integer/sparse numerical maps, and output only consensus predictions; contradictions invalidate hypotheses, not gradient-update weights. Changed-grammar role re-binding uses phase B only.
learning: Zero gradient updates for candidate; deterministic bounded finite rule search with explicit node and memory counters. Conventional smoke is not strong fully trained control.
metrics: Phase A heldout exact state accuracy and wrong-confident fraction
Changed-grammar Phase B heldout exact state and wrong-confident fraction
retention of Phase A after B
search node count, wall/CPU, persistent memory including code/logic
comparison against existing selftest count-only and weak conventional
development_success: Exploratory/engineering: zero gradients and no hidden source imports, 12 SELFTEST fixture support, reproducible bounded outputs, cold restore, and at least one nontrivial grounded compositional correct heldout prediction without wrong-confident ambiguity. Failure remains a negative prototype outcome, not proof the whole approach is false.
science_gate: No WSP54 DEV/PRIMARY or SCIENTIFIC_PASS from SELFTEST. Before scientific admission: independent fully trained recurrent baseline, exhaustive symbolic search under fair shared priors, exact source custody, frozen non-SELFTEST thresholds and budgets, qualified resources and separate authorization. Comparative scientific standards not weakened from WSP53.
stop_rules: Never inspect WSP53 DEV/PRIMARY labels or invoke WSP53 first-use
No post-result retuning to relabel SELFTEST as science
No use of oracle model functions, true latent codebook or prewired true operator semantics inside learner
If feature identities or search exhaust, abstain instead of guessed confidence
No merge, promotion, owner loop integration or deployment
